Horizon Nav uses Mapbox for the map, live traffic, search and routes. It needs your own free Mapbox access token, so the map runs on your Mapbox account (it\'s free for personal use).
Horizon Nav works out when to leave with the traffic expected then, checks again half an hour before, and reminds you 10 minutes before and when it\'s time to go (while the app is open).
